core_claim.P: When enforcing the maxNumLimitsPerSide cap in _processLimitAskOrder(), expired orders are not filtered or removed before the ds.askTree.size() capacity check
core_claim.I: The per-side limit order book capacity check must count only active/actionable orders, not expired ones
core_claim.V: Expired orders occupy book space and cause valid limit orders to be rejected as if the book were full

distinct_impacts.description: Griefing the system by occupying book space with expired orders, preventing valid limit orders from being posted
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: This oversight allows for griefing the system by occupying book space with expired orders, effectively preventing valid limit orders from being posted.

distinct_impacts.description: More competitive and valid limit orders may be denied because the book is perceived as full despite resident orders being inactive or expired
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: more competitive and valid limit orders may be denied simply because the book is perceived as full, even though many of the resident orders are inactive or expired

distinct_impacts.description: Freezing one side of the book
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: freezing one side of the book.

distinct_impacts.description: Market disruption: unfair rejection of competitive orders experienced by traders
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Market Disruption — Traders may experience unfair rejection of competitive orders.

distinct_impacts.description: Potential censorship: malicious actors could selectively deny participation for specific price ranges or actors because expiration range isn't checked at order posting
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Potential for Censorship — Malicious actors could selectively deny participation for specific price ranges or actors since at order posting expiration range isn't checked

distinct_impacts.description: Capacity check counts all orders via ds.askTree.size() regardless of expired or actionable status, with no removal/invalidation logic before the check
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: ds.askTree.size() includes all orders, regardless of whether they are expired or actionable. There is no logic to remove, or invalidate expired limit orders before this capacity check.
